name: team-topologies-modeler
description: Team Topologies for Claude: the method after Skelton & Pais (the four team types, the three interaction modes, cognitive load, fracture planes, topology reviews with feedback annotations) and the `.tt` / `.ttm.json` file format of the Team Topologies Modeler (fields, coordinates, layout grid and a dependency-free checker), so Claude can design, draw, review and edit Team Topologies diagrams as plain JSON.
